basis: IBKR TWR (flow-neutral) vs benchmark total price return; benchmarks IBKR daily closes
caveats: TWR is flow-neutral so the July capital inflows (111k->1.02M NLV) do NOT inflate the return - this is a real per-dollar comparison
66 sessions is NOT statistically significant; ~1/3 of the window ran at sub-$250k NLV where single positions moved the percentage
the low vol/DD is substantially a CASH artifact: 33% of NLV is SGOV + the book was majority-cash for much of the window - beta-adjusted, the equity sleeve's risk is higher than 11.4% implies
AI-BREAK-relevant: QQQ ran -4.8% worst day and -11.3% max DD in this window while SPX held -4.5% - the Nasdaq stress the ensemble forecasts is ALREADY showing in the tape
no benchmark dividends included (price return); SPY/IWM ~0.3-0.4pp understated over the window
attribution_owed: per-name P&L decomposition not run - the excess is unattributed between (a) name selection, (b) cash drag AVOIDED in QQQ's drawdown, (c) FX/international sleeve

decomposition_20260803.method: cash strip via TWR identity r_tot = w_eq*r_eq + w_cash*r_cash with time-averaged equity weight ~86% (pre-July book was ~88% deployed at $55-236k NLV; post-inflow 68%); name attribution from live unrealized P&L on current positions (realized/closed P&L NOT included - see gaps)
decomposition_20260803.finding: cash was NOT the alpha - stripping it INCREASES excess (8.2pp -> 10.5pp vs SPY) because the cash yielded only 1.11% over the window while the equity sleeve compounded. The low headline vol WAS partly cash (11.4% -> 13.3% adjusted = SPY-like), but the drawdown advantage survives (-3.0% vs SPY -4.5%, QQQ -11.3%)

name_attribution_current_positions.concentration: top-3 names = $18.1k = 57% of total unrealized; top-10 = ~$29.7k = 94%

GAPS_do_not_overclaim: REALIZED P&L excluded - the attribution covers only positions still open; closed trades (incl. the meme-CC overrun exits) are missing, so name-level attribution is INCOMPLETE

current-position unrealized ($31.5k) reconciles to only ~1/4 of the TWR gain on the current base - most of the window's return was earned on a much smaller NAV where percentage moves were large in RATE but small in DOLLARS; this is the single most important caveat
HUBS/CTSH/MNDY/SAP/NOW are TECH - the sleeve BEAT QQQ partly by owning tech that outperformed QQQ, not by avoiding tech; the containment read must not be over-drawn
equity weight path is estimated (0.88/0.80/0.68 buckets), not reconstructed from daily gross-position history - r_eq has ~+/-1pp of method error
66 sessions, no benchmark dividends, no factor/beta adjustment - a beta-1.0 assumption is doing work in the excess numbers
